prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Create SIX complete full-body frames of Cecilia's cute sleepy nod and waking recovery. One action source sheet, not full pet atlas.
Reference image 1 is the strict canonical identity, delicate 2D anime sprite style, exact proportions and official costume. Reference image 2 is the approved original pet atlas for consistent face and body only, not layout.
Keep mint-green long hair, green eyes when open, cream scalloped lace head veil/cape, white sleeves, navy pleated skirt and cream lace hem, dark stockings and small dark shoes. Fine soft outlines, subtle cel shading, exactly the established pet.
Arrange TWO ROWS of THREE separated figures, reading top-left, top-middle, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-middle, bottom-right. Landscape 3:2 canvas, matching whole-figure drawing scale throughout. Wide transparent gutters and an empty horizontal gap between rows. All complete figures including hair and shoes have safe margins from frame/canvas edges. Feet stay grounded on the same row baseline; no walking or jump.
1 calm normal forward standing, open green eyes, relaxed hands.
2 sleepy heavy half-lidded eyes, tiny soft mouth, arms loosely resting, head tilts down a little.
3 eyes gently closed, head nods forward and neck/upper body lean slightly, hands close together in front.
4 deepest adorable sleepy nod: eyes closed, head bowed with shoulders gently relaxed and hands loosely together; retain face visibility and natural head/neck mechanics, no full body shrinking.
5 head rises back up, eyes begin opening, tiny content smile, shoulders return gently.
6 normal open green eyes and neutral standing restored, same pose and size as frame 1.
Independently draw expression and head posture for each frame; maintain identical head size. Hair and veil follow the gentle nod. No whole-character raster rotation, resizing or deformation.
Actual transparent background and clean alpha edges. No Z letters, text, numbers, symbols, tear drops, stars, props, shadow, scene, effect marks, motion lines, borders, guide marks or other characters. Six clean complete figures only.
qa: Native contact inspected: 6 complete silhouettes and consistent Cecilia identity, visibly sleepy half lids, bowed head and closed eyes, then recovery. Both feet remain grounded. Approximate hood-to-chin head heights 190-215px across both source rows; bowing changes visible head shape naturally. No text/props/effects.
